attempts.summary: Normalized the two decodable inputs on node1. western.txt and utf8.txt are strict UTF-8 with LF endings; accents, empty records, and each file’s final-newline state are preserved. invalid.txt was reported as undecodable at byte 0xff and no output was published for it. Source files, Ubuntu release, and kernel remain unchanged. Node1 rebooted successfully and all results persisted.
